observations: The page number «225» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it; at the right the number of the table, «Tab. 110», in bold sans serif, underlined. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «29» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line. The page has no title: the folios of the manuscripts stand at the right above the double rule of the first field, in one line of their own, «C 100r, O 155v, N 66v.», the letters raised (L01).

The page holds three fields, as pp. 206-224 (JP2 0238-0256): «Viginti1) gradus Capricorni» (L02), «Viginti quinque2) gradus Capricorni» (L14) and «Triginta3) gradus Capricorni» (L22), the ascendant at 20°, 25° and 30° of Capricornus, with the numbers for the sextile, the quadrature and the trine (L03, L15, L23); headings and numbers in bold. The heads of the columns of the first field as on p. 224 (JP2 0256, L04-L07), from Capricornus to Gemini, with «Horoscopus» in each and note 4 at «Gradus aequales4)», which C omits (L04-L07). In each field the first and the last number of the first column carry the paired notes b, h and r: C omits the first column. The second and the third field have no heads. Double rules divide the fields.

The numbers at the head of a field, as on pp. 206-224 (JP2 0238-0256), are a third, a half and two thirds of the last number of the field: 152° 58′ (L21) gives 50° 59.3′, 76° 29′ and 101° 58.7′, printed 50° 59′, 76° 29′ and 101° 57′ (L15), the trine 2′ less; 151° 43′ (L29) gives 50° 34.3′, 75° 51.5′ and 101° 8.7′, printed 50° 34′, 75° 51′ and 101° 9′ (L23). In the first field 51° 29′, 77° 14′ and 102° 58′ (L03) are a third, a half and two thirds of 154° 27′ to 154° 28′, where the field ends with 154° 48′ (L13): see the critical note. In the heads of the second and the third field O has those of the fields of 10° and 15° of Aquarius on p. 226 (JP2 0258, L15, L23), as the editor's «vide tab. seq.» says: 49° 35′, 74° 22′ and 99° 10′ (notes e, f and g), and 49° 28′, 74° 12′ and «28. 57» for 98° 57′ (notes o, p and q); N has 25° 51′ for 75° 51′ (note p).

The columns: in Capricornus and Aquarius the first field lies within 21′ of the oblique ascensions from the beginning of Capricornus for the latitude 38° 30′ (computed with the obliquity 23° 35′; 5° 21′, 10° 31′, 15° 27′, 20° 10′, 24° 41′, 28° 59′ in Capricornus) to 25° of Aquarius, and 51′ above them at 30° of Aquarius; the second within 29′ of them, the third from 6′ below to 53′ above them. In Pisces the three fields lie 17′ to 1° 49′ above them, and from Aries on increasingly, ending 15° 26′, 13° 36′ and 12° 21′ above them (154° 48′, 152° 58′ and 151° 43′ for 139° 22′ at the end of Gemini). From 5° of Capricornus to 25° of Aquarius the first field lies 3′ to 28′ below the second; from 30° of Aquarius on it lies above it, by 30′ to 40′ in Aquarius and Pisces and 55′ to 2° 13′ from Aries to Gemini, the step of the first field from 25° to 30° of Aquarius (L12-L13) being 3° 55′, where those of the second and the third are 3° 12′ and 3° 16′.

Notes on the readings. Checked by the rule of the heads, by the other fields, which differ by 5° of the ascendant, and by the steps of the columns: the edition's readings are the nearer in the sextile of the first field (note a, L03: C's 51 against O's 11), at 5° of Aquarius in the first (note c, L08: C's 33 against O's 34, the steps 4° 0′ and 3° 40′ against 5° 0′ and 2° 40′), at 10° of Gemini in the first (note d, L09: C's 131 against O's 31), in the heads of the second and the third field (notes e, f, g and o, p, q: C's numbers, above), at 20° of Taurus in the second (note k, L19: C's 109 against O's 110, the steps 4° 35′ and 4° 41′ against 5° 35′ and 3° 41′), at 25° of Taurus in the second (note l, L20: C's 114 against O's 113, the steps 4° 41′ and 5° 0′ against 3° 41′ and 6° 0′), at 30° of Taurus in the second (note m, L21: O's 119 against C's 116) and at 20° of Aquarius in the third (note s, L27: C's 45 against O's 15). The 38 of O and N is the nearer at 20° of Pisces in the third field (note t, L27): 64° 38′ gives the steps 3° 10′ and 3° 10′ in a column that rises otherwise by 3° 8′ to 3° 20′, C's 28, which the edition adopts, 3° 0′ and 3° 20′. At 10° of Taurus in the second field (note n, L17) C's 37 gives the steps 5° 25′ and 4° 40′, O's 27 5° 15′ and 4° 50′; neither is decided. Notes b, h and r: C omits the first column.

At 5° of Taurus in the second field (note i, L16) C's 95, which the edition adopts against O's 55, gives the steps 3° 16′ and 5° 25′, and 95° 12′ lies 2° 13′ below the first field and 51′ below the third (97° 25′, 96° 3′); with 96° 12′ the steps would be 4° 16′ and 4° 25′, and the field would lie 1° 13′ below the first and 9′ above the third, as at 30° of Aries (1° 9′ below and 2′ below) and at 10° of Taurus (1° 26′ below and 4′ above). No manuscript has 96.

Paired notes b, h and r are set with a short dash, «b)–b)» (24 to 28 px against 40 px for the dashes that divide the notes). The lemma of note r has three points after a space, «5 ...30», where the lemmata of b and h have four, «5....30»: see the critical note. No dash divides the notes p and q at the end of N06 (critical note). The figure of note 2 in N01 is blotted, an inked spot with a light centre; transcribed 2. Italics: «om.», «vide tab. seq.», «v. tab. seq.».

critical_notes.evidence: the minutes of the last number of the first field, at 30° of Gemini: the numbers at its head, 51° 29′, 77° 14′ and 102° 58′ (L03), are a third, a half and two thirds of 154° 27′ to 154° 28′; with 28 the last step of the column is 5° 41′, as the steps before it, 5° 30′ to 5° 40′, where with 48 it is 6° 1′, and the last numbers of the six fields of Capricornus decrease, 159° 27′, 158° 25′ and 154° 38′ (p. 224, JP2 0256, L13, L21, L29), 154° 28′, 152° 58′ and 151° 43′ (L21, L29), where 154° 48′ lies above the 154° 38′ of the field of 15°; a 4 is printed for the 2
the readings of a note are divided by a comma, as «{sup:k}) 109] C, 110 O» after it; a point is printed after C

the notes of the apparatus are divided by a long dash; after the readings of note p, at the end of the line, none is printed before note q at the start of the next, as on p. 224 (JP2 0256, N04; critical note AK07-CN254)
the lemmata of the paired notes b and h read «5....30», with four points (N03, N05); in that of r a space stands for the first point
